ns2:course.label: Aerospace Decision Algorithms
ns2:course.description: Design, analysis, and application of decision algorithms to modern aerospace systems: global positioning systems, air traffic control systems, unmanned aerial vehicles, imaging and communication satellites, and planetary ground vehicles. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: AE 202, AE 352, AE 353, AE 370, ECE 205, ECE 206, and IE 300.
